text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm heading over to my
office...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Rain or shine, heaven or hell... I'll bring
the
thunder!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that's not it. I've gotta be more
like... "I'll
bring the THUNDERRR!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Urk! H-h-how long have you been
there?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You better not tell anyone about this!
Getting
caught practicing how to be
cool is like the
uncoolest thing ever!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that line's actually way cooler
than it
sounded just now. I just haven't
perfected it yet!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's from a scene in my favorite
delinquent
manga where the protag
vows to overthrow the
top brass and
declares war on the boss.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: They're all like, "Rain or shine, heaven or hell... I'll bring the thunder!" Maaaan! Talk about cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But it doesn't sound right when I say it,
y'know? I
dunno, I don't feel like I'm
being... menacing
enough. Hm...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Make myself look more threatening,
huh? I never
thought of that! The
characters in the manga are
all swole, so
that could work!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I get jacked like them, I might be able
to see
the world from their perspective!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sold! Time to get ripped! Thanks for
the tip!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, I hear around school that
Vodka's
been hitting the gym with
renewed vigor.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Intimidating poses, huh? I guess they do
strike
some sweet poses in the manga...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How's this? Or maybe somethin' like
this?
Whaddabout this? Man, posing
actually uses a lot
of muscles!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gettin' all pumped now! Y'know
what? I'mma
bring my mirror over.
Thanks for the tip!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's deep dive into posing
apparently
continues late into the night.
